title: Payment Terms Table for PracticePay Patient Financing Plans
content:
**Facet: payments, AutoPay, due day and prepayment.** These terms govern how a payment on a PracticePay Patient Financing plan is applied and accepted, whether AutoPay changes the rate, how often the due day may be changed and whether paying off early costs anything.

| Plan | Due-day changes allowed over the life of the plan |
|---|---|
| PracticePay 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 0 |
| PracticePay 6-Month No Interest Plan | 0 |
| PracticePay 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 12-Month No Interest Plan | 0 |
| PracticePay 24-Month Reduced APR Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 48-Month Reduced APR Plan | 1 |
| PracticePay 60-Month Extended Plan | 1 |

The following terms are identical on all seven plans:

| Term | Value on every plan |
|---|---|
| Order in which a payment is applied | billed interest and billed deferred interest, then fees, then the remaining plan balance |
| Amount paid beyond the monthly payment due | reduces the plan balance; does not advance the next due date |
| Same-day cutoff | payments submitted by 20:00 Eastern Time on a business day are effective that day (24-hour clock) |
| Largest single debit card payment | 2500.00 USD |
| AutoPay rate discount | 0.00 percentage points |
| Penalty for paying off early | 0.00 USD |

## Points of reading

- A payment of 2500.00 USD by debit card is within the limit; a single debit card payment above 2500.00 USD is not.
- A payment submitted at 20:00 Eastern Time on a business day is effective that day; one submitted after 20:00 is not.
- On the 6-Month Deferred Interest, 6-Month No Interest and 12-Month No Interest plans the due day cannot be changed at all; on the other four plans it can be changed once.
